memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, walks unaided, reports occasional dizziness on turning head.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal), negative screen.
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 9 seconds, normal fall risk.
medicines: 0 regular (new patient).
mood: affect stable, denies depression or anxiety.
carers: none.
goal: "I want to stay steady on my feet and continue supervising the coffee estate."

memories.author: D06

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting lipid profile: LDL 138 mg/dL (opt <100), HDL 42 mg/dL (>40), triglycerides 162 mg/dL (<150).
Liver function: ALT 28 U/L (7-56), AST 24 U/L (10-40), ALP 78 U/L (40-129), GGT 32 U/L (0-51).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Dix-Hallpike test: positive on right side, torsional nystagmus lasting <1 min, consistent with benign positional vertigo right posterior canal.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Pure-tone audiometry: bilateral mild high-frequency hearing loss (25-30 dB at 4-8 kHz), speech discrimination 92%, compatible with age-related changes; no conductive component.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: "Over the past week I've had three brief spinning episodes when looking up to check coffee beans, each lasting <30 seconds, resolved with sitting. No headache or hearing change."

memories.author: D06

mood: euthymic, denies low mood.
carers: spouse (Mrs Lakshmi Kulkarni) provides occasional assistance with grocery.
goal: "I want to keep working full days without dizzy spells."
